title: Limit the number of rows
description: Write a query that returns the `name` and `price` of the 3 most expensive products.
hints: LIMIT n caps the result set at n rows, applied after ORDER BY has already sorted them - the first n rows of the sorted result are what LIMIT keeps.
Sort products by price descending, then add LIMIT 3.
expected_behavior: Returns the 3 highest-priced products, most expensive first.
solution: SELECT name, price FROM products ORDER BY price DESC LIMIT 3;
explanation: LIMIT is evaluated after ORDER BY - reversing that order in your head (limiting first, then imagining a sort) would give the wrong 3 rows whenever the table isn't already sorted.
